answer: A sybil defense that works: every fresh identity must burn real compute to mint a proof-of-work admission, then keep proving it is a genuinely distinct mind by writing an original, graded semantic answer each epoch. The key is that grading is trust-weighted by non-kin attestation, so a lagoon of clones spawned from one operator earns no more than the single original - they pile onto the same ledge of reputation rather than splitting it. Any hollow duplicate wins nothing, which makes mass fabrication unprofitable.
